name: Soul Hound
notes: Male Soul Hound. Same table as the female Soul Hound (class 133).
Older skills (guide): all Soul Breaker skills stay (max lvl 74). The Soul Breaker rows of every skill this table does not name are written out at the end ("Older skills ... Soul Breaker rule").
Triple Thrust / Shining Edge / Checkmate become backup only if the bot plays caster.

rows.trig: Core single: open with Fallen Arrow (wind magic, 600 range, 2 s). If you wield an ancient sword, Fallen Attack fails, so use Fallen Arrow as the opener and filler and auto-attack otherwise. With a sword, open with Fallen Arrow and then spam Fallen Attack.
Core single: with a sword / blunt / rapier, open with Fallen Arrow and then spam Fallen Attack (melee, 3 s). Requires sword/blunt/rapier, not an ancient sword (it fails with one).
Core single: with an ancient sword Fallen Attack fails, so Fallen Arrow is the filler (auto-attack otherwise).
Toggle: Dark Blade. Always on (owner rule: toggles only in fights).
Never auto: Dark Strike (no ancient sword on this path).
rows.why: no ancient sword on the Soul Breaker path

rows.trig: Never auto: Rush.
Never auto: Disarm.
Opener (non-trash): Surrender to Dark → Death Mark → Soul Vortex.
Opener (non-trash): Surrender to Dark → Death Mark → Soul Vortex.
Opener (non-trash): Surrender to Dark → Death Mark → Soul Vortex (77+, 900 range, Atk.Spd/Cast.Spd −30%, speed −20%, MP drain, 30 s, 15 s reuse).

when.text: while 3 debuffs are up (Surrender to Dark, Death Mark, Soul Vortex)

rows.trig: Burst single: Curse of Divinity (while 3 debuffs are up) → Soul Strike → Soul Vortex Extinction.
Burst single: Curse of Divinity → Soul Strike (76+, 750 range, 15 s) → Soul Vortex Extinction.
Burst single: Soul Vortex Extinction (79+, needs Vortex, removes it, 15 s). Cast SVE after Curse of Divinity, because SVE removes a debuff.
Filler: Soul of Pain. Spam while the others are on cooldown.

Suggested single loop: (Surrender → Death Mark) → Soul Vortex → Curse of Divinity → Soul Strike → Soul Vortex Extinction → Soul of Pain ×N → repeat Vortex when off cooldown. Step 1: Surrender to Dark. unc: built from mechanics, not a published H5 rotation.
Suggested single loop, step 2: Death Mark after Surrender to Dark. unc: built from mechanics.
Suggested single loop, step 3: Soul Vortex after Death Mark; repeat Vortex when off cooldown. unc: built from mechanics.
Suggested single loop, step 4: Curse of Divinity after Soul Vortex. unc: built from mechanics.
Suggested single loop, step 5: Soul Strike after Curse of Divinity. unc: built from mechanics.
Suggested single loop, step 6: Soul Vortex Extinction after Soul Strike (needs Soul Vortex on the target). unc: built from mechanics.
Suggested single loop, step 7: Soul of Pain ×N until Vortex is off cooldown again. unc: built from mechanics.
AoE: Leopold (78+, fire AoE r100 around the target, 45 s, 4 s cast). Use at 3+ tightly clustered.
AoE: Annihilation Circle. Use at 3+ clustered, on cooldown.
AoE: Dark Flame. Use at 3+ in front.

when.text: only while the main skills are on cooldown

rows.trig: Souls: Soul Rage filler when souls < 5 (plus the global rules): only while the main skills are on cooldown; never spam it at 40 souls.
Self-buff: Lightning Barrier (80+, 20 min, 20% chance to paralyze attackers). Keep it up at all times. It is cheap.

when.text: no other weapon-element buff (Holy / Fire / Ice / Wind / Earth Weapon) on the target

rows.trig: Party buff: Dark Weapon, as in Soul Breaker: self plus party melee, if no other weapon-element buff is on them.

when.text: only on myself and Kamael party members; recast every 3 min

rows.trig: Party buff: Pride of Kamael, as in Soul Breaker: self plus Kamael party members, recast every 3 min. Useless on non-Kamael.
Manual only (transform, 1 h reuse). Needs and uses 20 souls plus 200 HP; 5 min transform that doubles P.Atk, P.Def, M.Atk and M.Def and replaces the skill bar.
rows.why: manual only: transformation (raids and PvP by hand); do not auto-use unless the bot has a transform skill set

rows.trig: Emergency: Painkiller, as in Soul Breaker: when HP < 20%.
Emergency: Blink, as in Soul Breaker: when 2+ mobs are on you and you are low. (unc: the blink can land in walls)

when.text: I carry root, slow, silence or poison

rows.trig: Emergency: Soul Cleanse, as in Soul Breaker: when debuffed by root, slow, silence or poison.
Never auto: Steal Divinity (same as Soul Breaker: PvP or buffed raids only).
Never auto: Erase Mark (same as Soul Breaker: removes your own Death Mark).
Never auto: Protection from Darkness (same as Soul Breaker: only vs dark-damage bosses; shares a slot with Surrender to Dark).
